band.name: Radiant Gray
band.tagline: We make bittersweet music for bittersweet people.

bio.portraitImageAlt: Radiant Gray standing together in front of a yellow brick wall
paragraphs: Radiant Gray started when four like minded musicians started looking for a creative outlet online. Currently based in the greater Philadelphia area, they're known for their distictive blend of rock, emo, and shoegaze influences.

With young people feeling more disconnected than ever, Radiant Gray seeks to create a community through music. Our mission is to bring DIY back to Philly and throw shows that allow people to forget their troubles for a night.
